digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 usage tracking and batch result aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) return only findings lists and discard per-call usage from runner results, leaving token totals unavailable for batch metrics and per-criterion request counts unrecorded.

Multi-criterion chunks and ladder retry attempts must each be tracked as distinct call records with their criteria list, and token fields must be equally divided across covered criteria while llm_calls and requests count in full per criterion.

run_focused_finder's internal run_bin calls accumulate usage that must be surfaced to callers (ProductionBatchRunner and fidelity_spot_eval) so prerequisite usage is merged into the aggregate before emission.
Checkpoint-resumed chunks from cache contribute no usage and raising attempts that trigger escalation contribute no call record, as their runner result is unavailable.
The sidecar payload must expose both raw per-call records (with criteria attribution) and per-criterion aggregate maps under the exact keys coverage.usage.per_call and coverage.usage.per_criterion.
